prompts.terrace_v2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied production cloud-terrace environment painting. Keep the entire gateway silhouette compact within the horizontal middle band from about 32% to 65% of image height, roughly 20% of canvas width; its feet rest convincingly on the terrace with correct perspective and a soft natural shadow.
